subject: AWS Marketplace telemetry snippet + seller onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Ashley Kim <ashley.kim@partnerco.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: aws-seller-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing copy + telemetry snippet for Acme AI

Hi Olga / Marissa —

Thanks again for walking through the Acme AI offer yesterday. AWS Seller Ops asked us to provide a short telemetry blurb that will appear on the product page (customers want to know what usage metrics/observability each SKU reports). I attached a draft product page and the SKU matrix.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a 2-3 sentence telemetry statement (what metrics are emitted, retention window, and whether logs/payloads are stored)?
- Can your team confirm the suggested marketplace entitlement mapping in the SKU matrix? AWS flagged a mismatch for the burst/commit tiers.

We’re aiming to finalize copy by EOD Friday so AWS can finish the offer acceptance flow next week.

Attachments: product_page_draft_v3.docx, sku_matrix.csv

Thanks —
Ashley
Partner Success Manager, PartnerCo
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ashley Kim <ashley.kim@partnerco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, aws-seller-ops@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing copy + telemetry snippet for Acme AI

Ashley —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers up front:
1) Telemetry blurb (suggested) — Redwood Inference exposes per-request token counts, inference latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and aggregated cost metrics to the customer’s CloudWatch/Marketplace telemetry feed. We retain aggregated metrics for 13 months; raw request payloads are not stored in persistent logging by default and can be disabled at the customer’s request.

2) Entitlement mapping — I reviewed sku_matrix.csv and highlighted the mismatch on the Burst SKU. The Burst SKU should map to the ReservedCompute:burst entitlement; we’ll send a corrected CSV.

Action items:
- I’ll attach an updated SKU matrix and a short copy block you can paste into the product page.
- Marissa, could you validate the hero copy aligns with our co-sell narrative?
- Ben, can you confirm we’re comfortable with 13 months retention for aggregated metrics or if legal wants 12?

Delivering updated files this afternoon.

—Olga
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ashley.kim@partnerco.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing copy + telemetry snippet for Acme AI

Thanks Olga —

Quick pass on hero copy: we should emphasize predictability and co-sell benefits rather than raw throughput claims. Suggested tweak: "Ship LLM inference with predictable latency and transparent telemetry — integrate with your Marketplace reporting and streamline procurement with reserved capacity SKUs."

Also recommended: add a short bulleted FAQ on telemetry under the Technical Details section that points to the CloudWatch integration.

I’ve reviewed the co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf and added a short paragraph for the AE enablement slide (how to position Burst vs. Commit SKUs during conversations).

Marissa
Head of Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ashley Kim <ashley.kim@partnerco.com>; aws-seller-ops@amazon.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com; ben.carter@redwood.com; devin@acme.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated assets: SKU matrix + product page copy (v4)

Ashley / AWS team —

Attached are the updated deliverables: product_page_draft_v4.docx (minor hero copy tweak), sku_matrix_corrected.csv, and co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf (Marissa’s AE notes included). Highlights:
- Telemetry blurb for product page (final): "Redwood Inference publishes aggregated inference metrics (per-request token counts and latency percentiles) to your Marketplace telemetry stream. Aggregated metrics are retained for 13 months; by default we do not persist raw request payloads. Customers can opt-out of telemetry logging via account settings."
- SKU mapping corrected: Burst -> ReservedCompute:burst; Commit -> ReservedCompute:commit; Trial -> OnDemand.
- AE playbook: call out cost vs latency trade-offs and the recommended talking points for procurement.

Next steps: AWS to confirm whether metadata redaction notes need to appear on the product page; Acme to sign the marketplace onboarding checklist after AWS acceptance.

Attachments: product_page_draft_v4.docx, sku_matrix_corrected.csv, co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf

—Olga
From: AWS Seller Ops <aws-seller-ops@amazon.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com; ashley.kim@partnerco.com; marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace telemetry snippet + seller onboarding checklist

Thanks everyone —

We reviewed the updated copy and the corrected SKU mapping. Two quick notes before we move to offer acceptance:
1) For the telemetry statement, please replace "13 months" with "12 months" to match our marketplace retention standard.
2) Please include a one-line sentence about data residency (e.g., "Telemetry is emitted to the Marketplace telemetry stream in the same AWS region as the deployed offering").

If you can update those items, we’ll proceed with the listing activation and co-sell enablement.

Regards,
Sophie (on behalf of AWS Seller Ops)
Marketplace Listings Team
